item.title: Remus Stealer Adds a Mailbox Persistence Module: FIXTURE Lab Investigates
item.dc:creator: FIXTURE Analyst
item.description: The Remus Stealer developer is advertising a module that keeps mailbox access after a password reset…
item.content:encoded:
Remus Stealer / November 9, 2026

FIXTURE Lab reviewed a forum post in which the Remus Stealer developer advertises a module that keeps mailbox access after the victim resets their password. The claim has not been independently verified; it is not a zero-day.

Defenders should review session token reuse and revoke refresh tokens after a stealer infection.

The post Remus Stealer Adds a Mailbox Persistence Module appeared first on FIXTURE Stealer Research.
